_: Names for the nameless (owner, 2026-09-23): the first time an addon introduces a generic NPC -- a Settler, a Drifter, a base not flagged Unique -- Rapport gives them a first name and a surname, the same ones forever, and keeps who was introduced in the save. The lists are built into Rapport; add "female", "male" or "surnames" arrays here to replace one. The player's MCM [Names] section overrides "enabled"; scripts/build-mcm.py makes the MCM default from this file.
